body:
New research project `research/twin-elicitation` (MIT), companion to `twin-transfer` and `randomized-twin`.

- Cost-paid vs Brier-paid twin providers elicit different twins (decision-equivalent estimate); small-variance law verified.
- Certainty-equivalence loss is quartic in posterior spread.
- Equal-Brier reports have regret ratios of 1.3–24x.
- Payment cap makes the elicited gain jump at a closed-form threshold M*.
- Brier mispays probing (15x spread in decision value per unit variance).

8 tests pass; README and site/projects.json updated; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
